title: Vier Minuten
setting: A long table after a rehearsal, five people, and a story delivered at the volume of a weather report.

steps.speaker: Beat
steps.es: Im Winter bauen sie die Brücke ab. Wegen dem Eis.
steps.en: In winter they take the bridge down. Because of the ice.

options.feedback: Friendly, short, and the best defence there is. About half the time you will be wrong.

options.es: Und wie kommt man dann über den Fluss?
options.en: And how do you get across the river then?
options.feedback: You are in. It is not a disaster: the four minutes are the joke and you are giving them to him.
Right, and sharp. Doch in the middle turns it into an accusation.

steps.speaker: Beat
steps.es: Doch, doch. Jedes Jahr im November, Stück für Stück.
steps.en: Oh yes. Every year in November, piece by piece.

options.es: Und im März wieder auf, ja?
options.en: And back up again in March, is it?
options.feedback: You have found it and you are playing along instead of announcing it. That is the whole art.
The question that hands him the table. Everybody will laugh and it will be fine.

options.es: Ich weiss, dass das nicht stimmt.
options.en: I know that is not true.
options.feedback: Announcing that you spotted it ends the joke and makes it about you.

steps.speaker: Fatlum
steps.es: Er macht das mit allen. Beim ersten Mal glauben es alle.
steps.en: He does that with everybody. The first time everybody believes it.

options.feedback: Grumble and laugh along. That is the answer, and it is over in two seconds.

options.es: Bei uns macht man solche Witze nicht.
options.en: We do not make jokes like that where I come from.
options.feedback: They only do it to people they have decided about. That sentence turns a welcome into a complaint.

options.es: Wie lange geht das schon so?
options.en: How long has this been going on?
options.feedback: Fine, and it keeps the spotlight on you for another minute.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Nach drei Jahren tönt er immer noch wie ein Wetterbericht.
steps.en: After three years he still sounds like a weather report.

options.en: On the other hand the Germans understand me.
options.feedback: Six words, at the person who started it, once. Two seconds of silence and then it lands.

options.es: Ich rede halt langsam, das ist normal beim Lernen.
options.en: I just talk slowly, that is normal when you are learning.
options.feedback: True, and explaining is the one thing that cannot be funny.

options.es: Und du tönst wie ein Traktor.
options.en: And you sound like a tractor.
options.feedback: Right shape, wrong aim: it says nothing back about what he actually said.
